note: The realization choices of the provisional realization A01-R2, the goal version (docs/audits/conformance/stage-b/provisional-realizations.json), named by it and read ONLY where A01's authorization record has that realization tried. Added 26 October 2026 (Stage F). A REALIZER's input, not knowledge, and his choice for this one activity, never the possession game form's. The same EXPLICIT REPLACEMENT rule as A01-R1's file (supplied-realization.ts): an entry here closes a line the game form's file also closes only by declaring `replaces`. A01-R2 is a variant of A01-R1, so its kept items keep A01-R1's item ids under its own contract, and their lines are named c:provisional:A01-R2:A01-R1-...; these entries are A01-R1's file's, re-pointed to A01-R2, with three differences: (1) no noun for the possession game's target at the axis-start end (c:restated:GF2:GF2-03.e::S3) - the game form's entry for it is WITHDRAWN instead - because in the goal version that region yields with the reference pointing to it (ruling C63) and the goal stands in its place, so the line is not open; (2) the three build-out restart stand-ins name the bound of his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 8 ("This flexibility should operate within the authorized deep starting environment, rather than permit arbitrary locations anywhere on the field.") in place of the post-regain area, which the goal version does not hold (A01-R1-T4-4 withdrawn, A01-R2-T4-5 added); (3) nothing else. Every stand-in's words are DRAFT coach wording; A01-R2 is listed and not tried until his open decisions (D-GOAL-SUITABILITY, D-PENALTY-AREA), so none of them is said to a coach yet. ONE COMMON RESTART, 24 October 2026 (R1, the d27 design's section 2.5): the four end-line stand-ins go with the end-line restart items withdrawn from A01-R1; the build-out restarts after the ball goes out and after the coach's two other stoppages (A01-R1-T1-8 to T1-11, kept from A01-R1) take the same bound as the start, a score and the coach's conclusion; and that bound's DRAFT words become "consistent with the intended build-out situation, on the building team's side of the marked line", for his reply filed 27 October 2026, item 6 ("The building team’s side of the marked progression line is an acceptable initial restart region."). A01-R2 is still listed and not tried, so none of them is said to a coach yet. AMENDED 24 October 2026 (K3, the d27 design's stage K3): 'A01-R2 is listed and not tried until his open decisions' and 'A01-R2 is still listed and not tried, so none of them is said to a coach yet' are no longer true. His reply filed 27 October 2026 settles the goal version's decisions (A01's gaps D-GOAL-SUITABILITY, D-PENALTY-AREA and D-DEFAULT-LAWS), so A01's record has this realization tried, first, and where the session states a goal that suits it these stand-ins' DRAFT words are said to the coach.

choices.because: Not the possession game's to choose in this activity: in the goal version the region at the axis-start end (GF2-03.e) yields together with the objective reference pointing to it (GF2-08.f, ruling C63), and the goal (A01-R2-O1-1) is the pressing team's target in its place - his reply filed 25 October 2026, item 3, "I approve a goalkeeper-protected physical goal as an authorized alternative to the pressing team's 5 m target zone within the Goalkeeper Build-Out context." Left in, the game form's choice of a noun for that region would be a choice for a line that is not open, and realization would refuse it.

The building team's target is a zone, as in A01-R1: in the goal version the building role holds the same end in both blocks (the end exchange, A01-R2-B10-1), so its target is the region at the axis-end end in both, beginning at the pressure reference (A01-R1-S5-2, kept) - his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 1: "Building team: Controlled progression beyond the marked line during an active goalkeeper-initiated build-out." and "The game form's existing line-or-zone progression structure, together with Goalkeeper Build-Out's approved scoring knowledge, should continue to govern the building team." Zone is one of the two nouns the possession game permits (GF2-03.b). Replaces the possession game's entry (a line), for this activity only.

The primary event is the building team's, as in A01-R1: entry into its target zone beyond the marked line, one of the kinds Goalkeeper Build-Out approves (RPC-001-08.a), his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 1: "Building team: Controlled progression beyond the marked line during an active goalkeeper-initiated build-out." The pressing team scores by its own event, a goal (A01-R2-B9-1, row B9), not by this one. Replaces the possession game's line_crossed, which a zone would contradict, for this activity only.
